def similar_elements(list1, list2):
    """
    Returns a set containing elements shared between two lists.
    
    Args:
        list1 (iterable): First collection of items.
        list2 (iterable): Second collection of items.
        
    Returns:
        set: A set of common elements found in both inputs.
    """
    return set(list1) & set(list2)

# Example usage and assertion test
if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10))
    expected = {4, 5}
    
    # Verify the output matches expectations regardless of order or internal set representation
    assert result == expected, f"Expected {expected}, got {result}"
    print("Test passed successfully!")
